item.title: Social Security's main trust fund faces depletion in 2032, triggering benefit cuts
item.description: Social Security benefits are facing automatic cuts starting in 2032 when a key trust fund is expected to reach insolvency, according to new CBO report.

item.title: Hyatt Hotels Executive Chairman Thomas Pritzker resigns over Epstein ties: 'I deeply regret... my association'
item.description: Hyatt Hotels Executive Chairman Thomas Pritzker stepped down Monday after DOJ documents revealed his association with Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Texas capital’s household growth surges, far outpacing national rate
item.description: Austin's population boom spans all ages as NAR data shows young professionals and seniors driving household growth, creating diverse housing demand across the Texas region.

item.title: LARRY KUDLOW: Will Europe and the rest of the world listen to Marco Rubio?
item.description: America, he avers, has no interest to operate a global welfare state or atone for the purported sins of past generations.

item.title: Costco issues recall for certain gift cards
item.description: Retail giant Costco recalled Synergy restaurant gift cards after the third-party issuer filed for bankruptcy, leaving left cards unredeemable.

item.title: Major Texas university adds Shein to list of banned Chinese companies
item.description: University of Texas at Austin bans Shein from campus networks following Gov. Abbott's directive targeting Chinese companies over cybersecurity concerns.

item.title: Americans shatter air travel record in 2025 despite surprising shift in when they fly
item.description: Americans broke air travel records in 2025 with over 904 million passengers screened at TSA checkpoints, but growth slowed compared to previous years.

item.title: Multistate outbreak of highly drug-resistant salmonella linked to trendy 'superfood,' feds warn
item.description: Drug-resistant Salmonella outbreak linked to moringa powder supplements prompts urgent recall. Seven infected across multiple states, three hospitalized.

item.title: Judge dismisses lawsuit over Buffalo Wild Wings’ ‘boneless wings’
item.description: A federal judge dismissed a lawsuit claiming Buffalo Wild Wings falsely advertised its boneless wings, ruling that reasonable consumers would not be misled by the name.

item.title: Tesla dodges California license suspension after dropping misleading 'autopilot' marketing terms
item.description: Tesla avoids California license suspension after stopping "autopilot" use in marketing following state DMV order over misleading advertising practices.
